bounds: One model-free native media profile, two selected payers, an unbound state, one selected Cloud image-model environment binding and one preserved owner-data token. State represents completed TS profile and native JVM environment projections, not atomic cross-process writes.
limitations: No concurrent boot, partial disk writes or process crash model. Native model-env admission, Direct retirement and unbound retirement execute through the actual compiled Java classes. Default native local-model preferences and custom Cloud-base/fenced-clear contracts retain their existing owning checks.

Weak fairness assumes a valid Cloud binding is eventually admitted and applied; it does not assume provider availability or image recognition. Coverage is TS profile projection, JVM env binding and actual SDK HTTP over a synthetic local server. It creates no IMAGE_DESCRIPTION local routing slot. New Pixel vision acceptance remains separate.
The unbound state means no admitted Cloud image-model environment binding. The media fields are admitted-route projections; this model does not assert that persisted TS serviceRouting is erased.

assumptions: Weak fairness of applying a valid Cloud binding.
